title: Transition areas (LOI)
summary: Wetland transition areas (buffers) NJDEP approved in Letters of Interpretation, from the applicants' surveyed plans.

source.where: (HPOS_AC_RP IS NULL OR HPOS_AC_RP <> 'TEST') AND (HPOS_AC_V IS NULL OR HPOS_AC_V <> 'TEST') AND (LOG_CON_RP IS NULL OR LOG_CON_RP <> 'TEST')
source.publisher: New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection (NJDEP), Division of Land Resource Protection

license.attribution: This map was developed using New Jersey Department of Environmental Protection Geographic Information System digital data, but this secondary product has not been verified by NJDEP and is not state-authorized or endorsed.

coverage.note: Only sites with an NJDEP Letter of Interpretation whose surveyed lines were filed digitally; elsewhere wetland lines are unverified.

export_notes.text: A Letter of Interpretation is valid for five years unless NJDEP extends it. Confirm its status with NJDEP's Division of Land Resource Protection before relying on these lines.
